description:
Cast Phyrexian Marauder by paying {0}.
Phyrexian Marauder enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary and Amareth trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Marauder on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to reveal Phyrexian Marauder from the top of your library and put it into your hand.
Repeat.
